content: MS Learn rest-api-versioning (updated 2026-07-23): after an API is released its -preview version is deprecated and can be deactivated after 12 weeks; deactivated preview versions are rejected. Services supports 1.0-7.0 per table (SDK v7.1.0 sends 7.1-preview.N; SDK b5 sends 5.1 and 5.1-preview.N for GetAllTeams, comments, ReorderBacklogWorkItems).
